name: Thornwood Edge
opening: The road ends at a signpost. Both arrows point into the dark trees, and both have been scratched out. Between the pines, small lights blink on and off, as if something is watching you.
picture: a misty forest edge at twilight, a crossed-out wooden signpost, glowing lights between dark pines
beats: Find a safe path into the forest
Discover what the lights between the trees are
Help the wounded wolf that guards the old grove
style: misty teal, fireflies, deep pine shadows
secret: The lights are lost spirits, and the wolf is protecting them from a hungry witch.
